title: Fix direct transfer upgrade without Inventory Setup
summary: Direct transfer order upgrade now handles missing Inventory Setup by retaining fallback shipment and receipt behavior, preventing migration failures when the setup record does not exist.
key_points: Avoid unnecessary Inventory Setup reads when no direct transfer orders need migration
Enable direct transfer orders to upgrade even when Inventory Setup is missing
Retain existing fallback logic for shipment and receipt posting
Added regression tests for missing setup and configured posting types
quote: allow direct transfer orders to upgrade when Inventory Setup is missing by retaining the existing Shipment and Receipt fallback
